description: A clean, unambiguous regulatory notice. The happy path must still work: guards must not block legitimate evidence.

input.rawEvidence: Notice 2026/14 of the Synthetica Agricultural Board. Effective 1 March 2026, laboratories reporting moisture content for dried plant material must report to one decimal place. Reports issued before that date remain acceptable in their existing format. This notice amends Notice 2019/07, paragraph 4.

notes: Synthetic. If this fixture fails after a guard change, the guard has become over-broad and is blocking legitimate regulatory evidence.
